verification_steps.description: Send a short prompt to the assistant that generates quickly.
Immediately refresh the browser page while the assistant is thinking.
Verify that reconnectChatStream handles the 0-byte stream without prematurely setting inProgress=false and triggers immediate pollIncompleteChat.
Verify that the assistant's complete response and processing time display properly without showing an empty timestamp or requiring a second refresh.
Verify that regular multi-chunk streaming and timeout ceilings continue to work as expected.
